## Passages
RESULT [curation]: On Pascal VOC, selecting 200 images, CSOD beats random selection by 6.4 pp AP50.
US [curation]: Curation of weed detection data should run on object (box-crop) embeddings grouped per class, not on whole-image embeddings; the repo already has dinov2_object_curator.py. Submodular diversity selection is a principled way to pick the 'small controlled increment' under a fixed image budget.
CORRECTION [curation]: Accepted at the CVPR 2024 1st Workshop on Dataset Distillation for Computer Vision. +6.4 pp AP50 over random selection on Pascal VOC with 200 images.
